svg.text: 568-70.9001 sheet 6 (redrawn): connection of the cut-control module BMR1, inputs 1-18
(25, number cut off on the photo) connection of the cut-control module (PŘIPOJENÍ MODULU ŘÍZENÍ ŘEZU)
(26) cut start buttons S10, S11 (TLAČÍTKA SPOUŠTĚNÍ ŘEZU
(26) cut start buttons S10, S11 (TLAČÍTKA SPOUŠTĚNÍ ŘEZU
(28) knife position sensors S12, S13, S14 (SNÍMAČE POLOHY NOŽE
BMR1 cut-control module (MODUL ŘÍZENÍ ŘEZU): inputs 1-18 (outputs 19-29, 0V, +24V on sheet 7)
Knife-position sensors over one stroke (from the clean copy of sheet 6, timing diagram under columns 05-10 (photo 20261114_014537))
bar ends estimated ±10 % of the stroke; what a bar means (contact closed or sensor actuated): [?]

- BMR1 1 line: wired 5X11 -> bridge -> 6X11 -> 4XC2, as the hand correction on the clean copy (20261114_014439) and the blue wires on X11 5 and 6 in photo 20261102_144309; the print has 3X11/4X11 (20261113_194606). X11 5-6 is likely a bridged light-curtain place (estimated); the light curtain FF1 is not fitted.
- K2 contact at BMR1 17: wired 11-14 (hand "11" over "13" on 20261114_014513, marker 11K2 in photo 20261102_144324); print 13-14. Whether +24V on BMR1 17 allows or blocks the cut is not printed [?].
- KM6/KM7 feedback: print KM6 61-62 + KM7 62-61; photo: KM7 has only its built-in NC 21-22 (markers 21KM7, 22KM7), so KM7 is drawn 22-21 [?].
- SQ1, SQ2 drawn NO, S12, S13, S14 drawn NC, as printed; common terminal 1 of each sensor on 1X8 (+24V); no 0 V wire to the sensors is drawn on the print.
- Zone borders follow the columns of each zone's devices; columns 14-15 (Q2 7-8 loop) carry no zone title in the reading.

- Timing diagram: the print has two dashed START lines (at 0 and about 0.04 of the stroke). Under it the print draws the knife raised over the stack at START, an arrow down, the knife through the stack at the bottom (middle line), an arrow up and the knife back at the top (end line), the stack cut; drawn here simplified: filled blade, sheet lines, open

- ink: red notes on the annotated copy (20261113_194606), not print: "?+24 (не взим.)" (last word read [?]) in the BMR1 box above terminals 3-5; "26 „0“" at BMR1 1, "+26" at BMR1 4 and 6; triangles above 37X10, 41X10, 40X10 (outlined) and 38X10 (filled), none above 39X10; dotted triangles on the BMR1 4 line above KM6 61 and on the BMR1 14 line; red
"Норм „ON“" (normally ON) by SQ1 (20261113_194843). What the triangles mean is not written (on-site list).
- The +24V-bus arrows stand in the printed order: UZ1 K14 (from 34X10), TABLO (from the 33X10 line), 32X10, BMR1, PLC, 5UG50.
Devices on this sheet (from control_devices.csv; [?] = unclear, estimated = with likely error)
UG50 [sure] rectified and AC control supplies +27V +24V +33V ~24V ~48V (PLOŠNÝ SPOJ SE ZDROJI UG50); terminals 1-32; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 3, column 03-04

реза); one relay board, plate "BMR2" (photo 143021), maker not printed or seen; terminals 1-29, 0V (-), +24V (+); OM list 10.2 "BMR.." 900 010 0714; place: cabinet; device row: sheet

KM7 [sure] cut clutch contactor (STYKAČE SPOJKY ŘEZU KM6, KM7); coil 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 19

X8 [?] terminal strip of sensors S12, SQ1, SQ2 (S13, S14 too on sheet 6) (SVORKOVNICE SNÍMAČŮ S12, SQ1, SQ2); terminals 1-6 used; place: machine; device row: sheet 6, column 09-13

S13 [sure] knife position sensor on the cam of the cutting mechanism (SNÍMAČE NA VAČCE ŘEZOVÉHO ÚSTROJÍ); contact 2-1 drawn NC; place: machine; device row: sheet 6, column 12
S14 [sure] knife position sensor on the cam of the cutting mechanism (SNÍMAČE NA VAČCE ŘEZOVÉHO ÚSTROJÍ); contact 2-1 drawn NC; place: machine; device row: sheet 6, column 13

- Adast Maxima MS 115 PS (serial 578.0009, 1998), control circuits: inputs 1-18 of the cut-control module BMR1: two-hand start, contactor feedback, knife sensors, interlocks.
- Redrawn from the wiring set 568-70.9001 SCHEMA ZAPOJENÍ (MS 80 PS,DS MS 115 PS,DS), sheet 6; columns and zones as printed.

- Marks: dashed line or [?] = unclear (on-site check list, spec/control.md); contacts in the off state as printed; end names 1/2 of lamps, RC parts and diodes are this redraw's names (1 = feed end, 2 = return end).
